feeds.title: Ludwig Van » Toronto
feeds.description: Ludwig Van brings you classical music and artists from the streets of Toronto in the form of articles and write-ups. Ludwig Van represents the best of local classical music and opera and is curated by expserts with a passion for music.

feeds.title: La SCENA » Classical Music
feeds.description: Read articles on classical music brought to you by La Scena Musicale. La Scena Musicale is one of the world's most respected classical music, opera and jazz magazine.

feeds.title: Sarah Slean
feeds.description: Signed to Atlantic/Warner Records at the tender age of nineteen, 4-time Juno nominee and modern-day Renaissance woman Sarah Slean has since released 11 albums in over 10 countries worldwide. Over her 25-year career, Slean has published two volumes of poetry, starred in short films and a movie musical, and more. You can read updates from her life, about her music, and concert schedules from the news section.

feeds.title: The Montrealer » Classical Music
feeds.description: This sections brings you news, updates, stories, interviews from the world of classical music in Canada. The site also covers news and trends in categories such as business, entertainment, lifestyle, travel, and more.

feeds.title: This is Classical Guitar
feeds.description: This is Classical Guitar explores classical guitar featuring new videos by professional guitarists, free lessons, sheet music with videos, and interesting articles. The blog showcases the culture and education of the classical guitar to help students and viewers stay inspired.

feeds.title: The WholeNote Blog
feeds.description: The WholeNote started life in 1994 as a classical music column by flutist Allan Pulker in The Kensington Market DRUM. We ensure our readers of the most comprehensive possible coverage of Southern Ontario's endlessly fertile classical and post-classical music scene.

feeds.title: Raja, the genius
feeds.description: This site attempts to showcase the Indian musical genius - Ilayaraja and his work with both Western and Indian Classical music over the last 5 decades.

feeds.title: Analekta Blog
feeds.description: Founded in 1987 by François Mario Labbé, Analekta is the largest independent classical music production company in Canada. With its outstanding product quality and constant exploration of new ways to reach a wider audience, Analekta's catalog, artists, and very name have become synonymous with vitality and artistic accomplishment.
